title: Input: author business processes as PlanDefinitions

bpmnFiles.description: BPMN 2.0 XML files from the L2 DAK repository, normally input/business-processes/bpmn. Source files, not exported images: an image carries none of the structure this skill needs.

processId.description: Which bpmn:process to use when the file declares more than one.

isOverview.description: True for the key-business-processes overview diagram, which describes the health area rather than one process.

igRoot.description: Root of the L3 Implementation Guide being authored.

personas.description: Resolved ActorDefinition canonicals for the personas declared in the DAK, used to populate action.participant. Omit and every lane resolution becomes a flag rather than a link.

label.description: Display name as it appears in a BPMN lane.

identifierGrammar.description: How a dotted DAK activity identifier becomes a resource id. Owned by the Commons Steward, not chosen here; supplied so the transform is the same across guidelines.

existingPlanDefinitions.description: Paths to PlanDefinitions already authored. Regenerating over hand-edited content triggers the regeneration-conflict gate rather than overwriting.
